easter-egg:1.page: Secrets and Easter Eggs in GTA V
easter-egg:1.text: There is a hidden Alien Egg in the game files that can be spawned using third-party trainers. The egg glows in the dark when spawned. The Alien Egg was eventually added to GTA Online in the Gunrunning update as supplies that the player can steal. To trigger the mission, the player must complete 600 resupply missions and start a new one between 21:00 and 23:00. If all conditions are met, the game may randomly begin th

easter-egg:2.page: Secrets and Easter Eggs in GTA V
easter-egg:2.text: In Ludendorff, North Yankton, underneath the train bridge the crew passes in the Prologue, there is a frozen creek. The player is able to drive down an embankment and onto the ice, where an alien is visible, frozen underneath it. It can also be found during the mission Bury the Hatchet.

easter-egg:3.page: Secrets and Easter Eggs in GTA V
easter-egg:3.text: Using a black light/UV light on the blueprint map that comes with the Collector's Edition reveals markings, map legends, secrets and text. Most of the things that appear are pointing towards the existence of UFOs. Three of the collectible Spaceship Parts are also shown in the map.

easter-egg:4.page: Secrets and Easter Eggs in GTA V
easter-egg:4.text: Multiple UFOs can be seen, most of them only after 100% Completion is obtained. Three appear in the sky and one appears underwater.

easter-egg:5.page: Secrets and Easter Eggs in GTA V
easter-egg:5.text: Between 23:00 and 0:00, a female ghost appears on the eastern peak of Mount Gordo. It doesn't react to any actions the player takes towards it unless they get too close, in which case the ghost will then disappear until the player backs off. During the time it is present, the word "JOCK" appears written in blood below where the ghost is floating, and a distressed female voice can occasionally be heard. In an article

easter-egg:6.page: Secrets and Easter Eggs in GTA V
easter-egg:6.text: After eating all 27 Peyote Plants, golden ones will appear; one in a different location for each day of the week. When eaten, they will turn the player into Bigfoot. If consumed in order (from Sunday to Saturday), when eating the final plant, a dead animal will be lying nearby, along with the body of the Sasquatch Hunter from The Last One. Growling will cause a howl to sound from the distance, to which the player mus

easter-egg:7.page: Secrets and Easter Eggs in GTA V
easter-egg:7.text: In the mission Predator, Michael must use a sniper rifle fitted with a thermal scope to find the O'Neil brothers in the woods at night. If the player zooms in on the thermal heat dot in the bottom right, it appears to be the Sasquatch standing still. Shooting it does nothing and it abruptly disappears within a few seconds of being spotted.

easter-egg:8.page: Secrets and Easter Eggs in GTA V
easter-egg:8.text: Chupacabra Street is named after the Chupacabra, a Latin American cryptid.

easter-egg:9.page: Secrets and Easter Eggs in GTA V
easter-egg:9.text: A beta map of Los Santos can be found inside Los Santos Transit stations and the Vanilla Unicorn's employee area.

easter-egg:10.page: Secrets and Easter Eggs in GTA V
easter-egg:10.text: In both Vinewood Hills and Grapeseed, a Big O juice stand can be found with a large orange ball on top of it. Shooting or walking into the ball will cause it to detach and roll around. It has very little weight and can be moved easily.

easter-egg:11.page: Secrets and Easter Eggs in GTA V
easter-egg:11.text: Dialing 1-999-367-3767 will call an unlisted contact called "Black Cellphones", after which a small explosion will occur over the player's head and their phone color will be changed to black.

easter-egg:12.page: Secrets and Easter Eggs in GTA V
easter-egg:12.text: The Bodhi is named after Bodhi Ogg, the son of Trevor Philips' voice and motion capture actor Steven Ogg.

easter-egg:13.page: Secrets and Easter Eggs in GTA V
easter-egg:13.text: There is a wrecked pickup truck bed in Stab City with a real-life California license plate. As seen in alpha build screenshots published by Rockstar North developers, this is left over from when California license plates were used as placeholders for the San Andreas license plates. A sign in Sandy Shores advertises a business known as "Salton Sea Real Estate". This is likely an oversight, as the Salton Sea is the rea

easter-egg:14.page: Secrets and Easter Eggs in GTA V
easter-egg:14.text: Along Elgin Avenue in Vinewood Hills is a CNT billboard made to look like a TV, with its "screen" being breakable glass. It is possible to both launch vehicles and skydive through it. A nearly identical billboard can be found near the Los Santos International Airport; however, the glass on this one cannot be broken.

easter-egg:15.page: Secrets and Easter Eggs in GTA V
easter-egg:15.text: A Confederate States of America battle flag used to be hung at Braddock Farm and The Range. The latter's was replaced with an American flag in the enhanced edition, while the former's was covered by a sign reading, "Trespassers will be shot! Survivors will be shot again!" in 2017, at the same time as GTA Onlines Doomsday Heist update. If the sign is somehow removed, the battle flag can still be seen underneath.

easter-egg:16.page: Secrets and Easter Eggs in GTA V
easter-egg:16.text: On the Xbox 360 and PS3 versions, the face of Rockstar Leeds artist David Dixon (internally named with his initials "dd_signature") could be seen on the side of Mount Chiliad. In the enhanced editions, this face was replaced with a drawing of a rooster shaped to look like a penis.

easter-egg:17.page: Secrets and Easter Eggs in GTA V
easter-egg:17.text: Various instances of defacing graffiti and messages can be found around the map, some of which only appear as the story progresses. Along Interstate 2 in Downtown Los Santos is graffiti featuring the text "This is broken - Can I return it?" and a drawing of the American flag. This exact same text and drawing can also be seen on a banner along the train tracks in Rancho. On a wall of the Vespucci Beach Recreation Cent

easter-egg:18.page: Secrets and Easter Eggs in GTA V
easter-egg:18.text: At the north end of the Mount Chiliad train tunnel, a green smiley face with sharp teeth - known as Greentooth - can be seen spraypainted on the wall. This is an inside joke between videogame developers.

easter-egg:19.page: Secrets and Easter Eggs in GTA V
easter-egg:19.text: The name of the auto service business Ruedas De Fuego translates to "Fire Wheels" in English. This is possibly a reference to the Hot Wheels toy car brand.

easter-egg:20.page: Secrets and Easter Eggs in GTA V
easter-egg:20.text: During the Hunting side-activity, Trevor is instructed by Cletus Ewing to send him photographs of the animals he shoots. It is possible, however, to send them to other contacts instead. Their responses range from simply commenting on the picture, to utter confusion or disgust. Certain contacts have specific responses while others share randomized, generic ones. It is also possible to send Cletus a photograph of a dea

easter-egg:21.page: Secrets and Easter Eggs in GTA V
easter-egg:21.text: Combining the names of HVY and MTL - two heavy-duty vehicle manufacturers - spells out HVYMTL, a disemvoweling of "heavy metal".

easter-egg:22.page: Secrets and Easter Eggs in GTA V
easter-egg:22.text: A mysterious mural inside the tramway station atop Mount Chiliad includes a drawing of what appears to be a jetpack, leading to speculation that such a device might be hidden somewhere on the map, though it was later revealed that it was an unimplemented idea from the game developers. Although data files for a jetpack were present in the game, the vehicle itself was later scrapped for unknown reasons, though a simila

easter-egg:23.page: Secrets and Easter Eggs in GTA V
easter-egg:23.text: In the original versions of the game, on the Lucky Plucker menu boards, stickers for the real life beverages, Sprite (drink), Barq's, and Fanta could be seen. These were removed in the enhanced edition.

easter-egg:24.page: Secrets and Easter Eggs in GTA V
easter-egg:24.text: A donut advertised on the Bleeter page for Rusty Brown's Ring Donuts is called the Red Ring of Death donut. This is a reference to the infamous Xbox 360 error nicknamed the Xbox 360 technical problems.

easter-egg:25.page: Secrets and Easter Eggs in GTA V
easter-egg:25.text: contains numerous references to Rockstar Games and Rockstar North, the developers of the Grand Theft Auto series and the games' primary development team, respectively.

easter-egg:26.page: Secrets and Easter Eggs in GTA V
easter-egg:26.text: In East Los Santos, a Snowman is visible inside a room of the Fridgit warehouse, behind some boxes. The room cannot be entered, but can be seen through a gap in the door and fired into.

easter-egg:27.page: Secrets and Easter Eggs in GTA V
easter-egg:27.text: Throughout Blaine County and the Grand Senora Desert, various traces of serial killer Merle Abrahams - also known as "The Infinity Killer" due to his obsession with the number 8 and infinity - can be found. Following the clues can lead to the locations of his victims' bodies. In Sandy Shores, a newspaper clipping can be found that claims Abrahams passed away in 2004 while awaiting trial for the abduction, torture, an

easter-egg:28.page: Secrets and Easter Eggs in GTA V
easter-egg:28.text: There is a small floating white square in the sky and small white cube far beneath the map that contain the text "this does not exist"; the latter is unable to be seen in-game without mods. These are likely developer oversights.

easter-egg:29.page: Secrets and Easter Eggs in GTA V
easter-egg:29.text: Surrounding the map are underwater wrecks, ranging between planes, ships, military vehicles, a submarine, a Diving chamber, and even a UFO (see above). Amongst some of the wreckages, the player can find weapons, armor, health packs, and briefcases containing money.

easter-egg:30.page: Secrets and Easter Eggs in GTA V
easter-egg:30.text: A whale skeleton can be found underwater, just off of Banham Canyon.

easter-egg:31.page: Secrets and Easter Eggs in GTA V
easter-egg:31.text: A wrecked T-34 can be found at Rogers Salvage & Scrap.
